en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a busy street scene with a crowd gathered around an obelisk-like fountain. There are horse-drawn carriages and people in early 20th-century attire. The background includes a large building and trees. The top of the postcard reads, 'La Fontaine du Boulevard Hamidié.' The bottom left says, 'Souvenir de Salonique.' There is handwritten text and a date: '8-3-903.'
